title: BNCI 2014-004 Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 9 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class motor imagery (left vs. right hand), known as BCI Competition IV Dataset 2b (Graz data set B). Each participant completed five sessions: two screening sessions without feedback and three sessions with smiley feedback. Three bipolar EEG channels (C3, Cz, C4) were recorded at 250 Hz. This BIDS deposit was derived from the original files using MOABB.
methods_description: Participants performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left or right hand movements. Screening sessions comprised 120 trials without feedback, and feedback sessions comprised 160 trials with continuous smiley feedback. Three bipolar EEG channels (C3, Cz, C4) and three monopolar EOG channels were recorded at 250 Hz with g.tec amplifiers, a 0.5-100 Hz bandpass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter. The reference was the left mastoid and the ground was Fz.
